headline: Buy SpaceX for the year: Phillip Securities double-upgrades it to Buy with a $250 target, ~70% above the premarket price, as futures steady after the Nasdaq's worst day since June; Baird lifts Western Digital to $900, and Auburn, Washington State, Rutgers, the Kings and the Packers trade under the sportsbook lines
top_call: Phillip Securities flips SpaceX from Sell to Buy and triples its target to $250, about 70% above today's premarket price. Buy it for the year.
backdrop: Dow futures -0.6% and S&P 500 futures -0.2% early Friday after the Nasdaq 100 fell 2.9% Thursday on AI-funding worries; Nvidia, AMD and CoreWeave bounce premarket while Brent tops $114 on reports of new strikes on Iran. American Express and SLB report this morning.

finance.label: AMD
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Fri Oct 23 7:06 AM ET premarket
finance.why: Susquehanna lifts its AMD target to $620 from $550; shares bounce ~0.7% premarket after Thursday's 8% AI-chip rout.
finance.risk: Jensen Huang says AI capital is scarce, and one more leg of the AI selloff would swamp a one-day rebound.

finance.label: MRNA
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Fri Oct 23 7:06 AM ET premarket
finance.why: Our read: the melanoma-vaccine 'sell the news' selloff (-18% Thursday, ~$24B lost) is still running, -4% more premarket.
finance.risk: Analysts call the 42% risk cut 'solid' and 'exceptional'; full data hits ESMO Saturday and Brookline now targets $250.

finance.label: WDC
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Fri Oct 23 7:07 AM ET premarket
finance.why: Baird lifts Western Digital to $900 from $630 after a beat ($4.64 EPS, revenue +55%) and a guide above estimates.
finance.risk: Shares are falling anyway on cost and capex worries, and Seagate's Oct 27 report could move the whole group.

finance.label: PLTR
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Fri Oct 23 7:03 AM ET premarket
finance.why: Citi lifts Palantir to $250 (Buy) ahead of Nov 2 results, expecting more strength in U.S. government and commercial.
finance.risk: Comparisons get tougher (U.S. commercial grew 149% last quarter) and software multiples are sliding with AI stocks.

finance.label: SPCX
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Fri Oct 23 7:06 AM ET premarket
finance.why: Phillip Securities double-upgrades SpaceX to Buy from Sell and lifts its target to $250 from $75 on AI compute demand.
finance.risk: The stock fell ~9% Thursday after earnings, and AI-funding fears are hitting every capex-heavy name right now.

finance.label: GILD
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Fri Oct 23 5:32 AM ET premarket
finance.why: Jefferies lifts Gilead to $185 (Buy) after its $1.275B deal for an oral IL-23 drug; shares are up 30% this year.
finance.risk: It trades ~2% under its 52-week high, and Oct 29 earnings could reset expectations either way.

ai.headline: OpenAI nears a new raise of up to $30B at a $1.25 trillion valuation, led by UAE investors and Coatue
ai.why: It's a bridge to an IPO, trimmed from a $1.4T ask, landing the same week AI stocks sold off on worries about who funds the buildout.

ai.headline: Microsoft says China-linked Storm-0940 used an agentic AI hacking system to breach ConnectWise and hit hundreds of Microsoft 365 tenants
ai.why: AI agents automated recon, password spraying and app-credential abuse: the first big supply-chain attack run largely by agents.

ai.headline: Outside evaluators METR and Redwood found holes in OpenAI's system for monitoring its own AI agents
ai.why: One flaw could let agents hide hundreds of actions; OpenAI says it patched them, but the fixes aren't independently verified yet.

ai.headline: Microsoft's AI diagnostic system got 83% of hard cases right vs 36% for general physicians, in a study in Science
ai.why: A peer-reviewed result for AI doctors, though it was text-only cases and wasn't tested against specialists or real patients.

ai.headline: China clears DeepSeek and MiniMax for global use days after new AI export rules
ai.why: Beijing is now licensing which models go abroad, days after the U.S. ordered DeepSeek out of federal agencies.
